motions.name: wedding
motions.line: Holding someone else's memory is a heavy burden; it's like being a thief stealing happiness that never belonged to you. <>Now, you and I can safeguard this secret together, since we're accomplices after all.

motions.name: wedding_touch
motions.line: All my friends have passed on, and all my enemies have perished. I thought I couldn't care less, thought that I wasn't afraid of being alone, and thought I always managed to keep it under wraps. Alas, Commander, please grant me this tiny request. Let me just... lean on you a little, just for a moment.
